definition: a regular customer of a shop or café
description: A small, simple dockside cafe on a grey morning. A woman behind the counter pours tea from one white enamel mug into another next to a steel water urn, while bacon sizzles and steams on a griddle behind her. A bearded man in a brown work jacket and a yellow hi-vis vest steps up to the counter, picks up a pen and leans over a newspaper crossword. Mugs hang on hooks under a price board, another worker in a beanie waits behind, and cranes stand outside the window.
